cards.speaker: James
cards.text: I want {faction} properly settled, not just quiet. They're calmer than they were, and calmer isn't safe. A lasting good opinion in two weeks means a clash with them stays a phone call.

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: We took the heat out of {faction}. I want it kept out: their opinion of us raised another step this fortnight. Their patience is a lease, not a deed, and I'd rather not renew it at a raid's price.

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: Round two with {faction}. Same ground, same buyers, and they've not forgotten. I want them well inclined to us by the end of the fortnight. Do it once more and the ground is ours without a fight.
